verdict.rationale: The evidence pack shows no documented agent-commerce endpoint (MCP or UCP) on BigCommerce stores that shopping agents can use to discover products and build carts. The GraphQL Storefront API is a developer building block for headless storefronts, not an agent-commerce endpoint. The llms.txt probe and the 'AI-ready page actions' refer to the developer documentation site, not to store-side agent commerce. An ecommerce platform could plausibly ship this capability, so the axis applies and the verdict is none rather than na.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, a shopping agent can discover my store's products and build carts through a documented agent-commerce endpoint on the store (MCP/UCP), not by scraping
